# REVIT Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning (Dublin)

> Mobile carpet, sofa, mattress and rug cleaning at your home in Dublin, Ireland. Run by Bruno Sergio. Professional equipment, a careful four-step process (assess, pre-treat, agitate, extract) and a 48-hour satisfaction guarantee. Quotes are free and requested on WhatsApp with photos of the item.

## Key page

- [Carpet cleaning in Dublin, home page](/): services, real before/after photos, prices, quote builder, FAQ.

## Services and starting prices (EUR)

- Carpet, standard bedroom: from €35
- Carpet, living room: from €50
- Stairs & landing: from €45
- 1 / 2 / 3 bedrooms + stairs & landing package: from €90 / €120 / €145
- Sofa: from €25 per seat
- Full sofa suite (3-seater sofa + 2 armchairs): from €125
- Armchair / single upholstery piece: from €20
- Mattress: single from €35, double from €45, king from €50
- Rug: from €25
- Pet / odour treatment (add-on): from €20
- Minimum call-out fee: €45

Final price is confirmed after a quick assessment, before any work begins. Special rates are available for two or more services on the same visit.

## How to book

1. Send a message on WhatsApp with a few photos of what needs cleaning.
2. Get a clear, no-obligation quote.
3. Agree a date and time.
4. REVIT cleans at your home and leaves aftercare tips.

## Equipment and products

Professional extraction machine for deep carpet and upholstery cleaning, specialist pre-treatments matched to the type of soiling, and professional cleaning solutions that are safe for children, pets and everyone at home.

## Guarantee

48-hour satisfaction guarantee: if there is a problem related to the service within 48 hours, REVIT assesses it and, where applicable, re-cleans the area at no extra cost, in line with the guarantee terms.
